name: Smelt On, Smelt Off
label: Quest
description: Smelt On, Smelt Off: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many blacksmiths believe that mining and smithing are separate, independent jobs; but can there be blacksmithing without mining? Ah ha -- it is an impossibility! The accomplished blacksmith must also be an accomplished miner.
Show Galvan that you are capable, friend. Bring me forty bars of iron and forty bars of mithril. For this, Galvan will teach you the ways of the ornate mithril pants!

clips.title: Progress
paras: After such mining, your muscles bulge and your body aches!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your work ethic is impeccable, friend! You are starting to understand the ways of Galvan mineralogy! Take this and learn from it all that you can.
